candidates.text: The Engineer/Quality-Engineer transport-repair budget is one correction per phase, not one per turn: once it is spent correcting an early staged turn's fenced/prose-wrapped reply, a later, independent transport violation on a *different* turn from the same agent (e.g. post_test_requested after pre_test_requested was already repaired) cannot receive a second correction and must block the phase immediately -- even when the visible source diff looks minimal and correct on inspection. Do not be tempted to grant a second correction just because the underlying work looks fine; the protocol's whole point is that a subagent's self-reported correctness is never trusted over its own contract compliance.
